title: first working hmph: run a command, write ticks.tbl and summary.tbl
body: The layers in CLAUDE.md, each a child. Done when hmph run -- <cmd> writes a timeline and a summary for a multi-threaded command with children, and the summary's cpu total reconciles against the root's rusage.
close_reason: hmph run -- ./work.sh (sh loops around xz -T4) writes all four tables; accounted cpu came within 0.01-0.4 s of rusage, the gap being the last interval of each process that died between ticks
